channel.title: Blow Your Mind
channel.desc: Dr Chris and Dr Xand van Tulleken bring you the top space experts on the planet to show you things that will truly Blow Your Mind! In this episode they find out all about the momentous moon and how it affects our oceans and tides. They discover that things would get a little soggy if the moon got any closer to Earth. And their moon expert friend Dr Maggie investigates if the full moon really does make people do weird things.
